name: Cash Account Return Criteria 5
definition: Defines the criteria used to report on an account.

NameIndicator.name: Name Indicator
NameIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account name is requested.

CurrencyIndicator.name: Currency Indicator
CurrencyIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account currency is requested.

TypeIndicator.name: Type Indicator
TypeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account type is requested.

MultilateralLimitIndicator.name: Multilateral Limit Indicator
MultilateralLimitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the multilateral limit is requested.

MultilateralBalanceReturnCriteria.name: Multilateral Balance Return Criteria
MultilateralBalanceReturnCriteria.definition: Defines the criteria used to report on a multilateral balance.

BilateralLimitIndicator.name: Bilateral Limit Indicator
BilateralLimitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the bilateral limit is requested.

BilateralBalanceReturnCriteria.name: Bilateral Balance Return Criteria
BilateralBalanceReturnCriteria.definition: Defines the criteria used to report on a bilateral balance.

StandingOrderIndicator.name: Standing Order Indicator
StandingOrderIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account standing order is requested.

AccountOwnerIndicator.name: Account Owner Indicator
AccountOwnerIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account owner information is requested.

AccountServicerIndicator.name: Account Servicer Indicator
AccountServicerIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the account servicer information is requested.
